title: Learned transcriptomic selection identifies a pediatric-sepsis blood-marker pattern
summary: Three learned feature-selection approaches converged on CYSTM1, MMP8 and CD177 in public pediatric blood-expression data. The source reports higher expression and case-control discrimination in a further dataset. This is a retrospective molecular association, including a less-studied CYSTM1 candidate, without established diagnostic specificity, clinical utility or causal treatment relevance.
ai_technology: Random forest, SVM recursive feature elimination and LASSO logistic feature selection
organization: Zhejiang University; Shaoxing People’s Hospital; Columbia University

evidence.tested: The analysis combined GSE26378 and GSE26440, with primary series metadata listing 180 septic-shock and 53 normal-control blood-expression profiles in total. Differential/module filtering preceded RF, SVM-RFE and tenfold-tuned LASSO selection. Their intersection identified CYSTM1, MMP8 and CD177. The paper reports increased expression and discrimination in GSE13904, a separately indexed pediatric inflammatory-spectrum dataset.
evidence.unknown: Distinct series/sample identifiers do not prove independent people. GSE13904 includes inflammatory-response, sepsis and septic-shock samples; the exact analytic subset and repeated-person separation were not independently reconstructed. Feature filtering used clinical labels before selection, and healthy-control contrasts do not establish real-world diagnostic specificity. Source prose twice refers to rheumatoid arthritis despite the sepsis analysis; no RA result is adopted. MMP8/CD177 links to sepsis were already known, and CYSTM1 remains a candidate association without functional or therapeutic validation. Reported ROC/decision curves do not demonstrate clinical benefit.
evidence.ai_role: The three learned selectors prioritized a shared measured-expression marker set after broad filtering, enabling the represented candidate-pattern and subsequent source-described case-control comparison. Immune deconvolution or network diagrams alone are not the admission basis.

source_review.scope: Read original computational cohort/filtering/RF/SVM-RFE/LASSO and ROC Methods, candidate/validation-expression Results and stated limits; separately read primary GEO series-level cohort metadata and exact GSM intersections. Patient-level independence and full validation subset were not reconstructed. No operational biological procedures or causal treatment claim. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
